_comment: Dependencies whose license is permissive but outside the spec's literal allowlist (MIT, BSD, ISC, Apache-2.0, MPL-2.0, public domain; SIL OFL for fonts). Each needs the human owner's approval; until then the checkers print them as warnings. See docs/DECISIONS.md D-008.

numpy.license: BSD-3-Clause AND 0BSD AND MIT AND Zlib AND CC0-1.0
numpy.why: Direct dependency for the seeded demo price generator; the Zlib part covers bundled code. Zlib is permissive.

typing_extensions.why: Transitive dependency of FastAPI and Pydantic; cannot be removed without dropping them. PSF-2.0 is permissive.

argparse.why: Dev-only, transitive (via the Playwright/Biome toolchain); not shipped in the web bundle.

@csstools/css-syntax-patches-for-csstree.why: Dev-only, transitive via jsdom for unit tests; MIT-0 is MIT without the attribution clause.
